issues.claim: American Tire & Auto Care, 2171 US-130, listed as an eligible independent tire/auto shop
issues.problem: This is a multi-location NJ chain: americantires.net lists 8 stores (Bordentown, Chester, Flemington, Green Brook, Mercerville, North Brunswick, Old Bridge, Westfield) and the North Brunswick store also appears as a Goodyear/Cooper-branded shop page. 'Chains and franchises' are an excluded type, and the mapper excluded every other chain in town, so this entry is inconsistent and remains an excluded type in the list. The mapper's own note also flags a name conflict with the legacy listing 'Tire Barn Inc'.
issues.fix: Delete the entry, or if it must be kept, justify it in writing as a locally-managed independent store (the 8-store locations page argues against that).

issues.claim: AFA Protective Systems, 961 Joyce Kilmer Ave, listed as a local security/alarm business
issues.problem: AFA is a regional multi-branch alarm company; the mapper's own note says it is unresolved whether the North Brunswick site is a local branch of a large firm (i.e. a branch of a chain rather than an independent local business). The entry rests only on Yellow Pages category listings, not on the company's own site.
issues.fix: Open afaaps.com (or the company's location page) and confirm whether this is a staffed local branch with local decision-making. If it is a branch of a large regional firm, drop it under the chain rule.

issues.problem: The listed 'website' is a third-party window-industry dealer/finder page, not the company's site. The company has its own active site, awhobor.com, which states it is 'here in North Brunswick, New Jersey', gives phone 732-247-3827 and NJ licence 13VH00049700.
issues.fix: Replace the website with https://awhobor.com/ (and note the street address is still not published on it).

issues.claim: Kenneth & Sons HVAC, 66 Georges Rd, North Brunswick (Google Maps only, no website)
issues.problem: The only third-party listing surfaced for this name places 66 Georges Rd in New Brunswick, not North Brunswick. The entry is supported solely by a Google Maps query URL (not a business-specific page), so both town and address are unverified.
issues.fix: Verify the address on a business-specific page (or by phone) before this entry is used; if it cannot be tied to a North Brunswick street address, remove it.

issues.claim: Coverage of landscaping: 'eleven firms remain' and the category is treated as well covered
issues.problem: A substantial North Brunswick landscaper is missing: DeVries Landscaping, 2442 NJ-27, North Brunswick Township (own site, family firm since 1953, phone (732) 297-1244).
issues.fix: Add DeVries Landscaping with address 2442 NJ-27 and phone (732) 297-1244.

issues.claim: Coverage of flooring: A Plus Flooring, Arias, Franco and A&J treated as the complete local set
issues.problem: Two North Brunswick-based flooring contractors found in my own searches are missing: Extreme Flooring (hardwood contractor 'based in North Brunswick Township', founded 1990, own site) and Y.A.J. Carpet & Flooring Installations LLC (BuildZoom lists it as North Brunswick-based).
issues.fix: Add Extreme Flooring (extremeflooring.com) and Y.A.J. Carpet & Flooring Installations LLC (BuildZoom profile) after a quick licence/address check.

issues.claim: Coverage of locksmiths: the six iBegin/1-800-Unlocks entries are the local set
issues.problem: Quick Lock Services (own site, 24/7 locksmith, North Brunswick) was deliberately excluded in data_gaps as 'lead-generation', but it publishes a North Brunswick address (832 Ridgewood Ave, Ste 2D per its contact page as returned in search) and a working phone (732) 807-8033. Its site is SEO-heavy but it is a real local operator of the same quality as several Angi-only entries the mapper kept.
issues.fix: Either add Quick Lock Services or restate the exclusion rule so the same standard is applied to the Angi-only and Nextdoor-only entries that were kept.

issues.claim: Coverage of cleaning: the eight listed cleaners are the local set
issues.problem: Two cleaners that surface consistently for North Brunswick are not listed: Hortensia Cleaning Service LLC (Angi, ~646 reviews, serving North Brunswick) and Seppy's Cleaning (Angi, North Brunswick address). Neither could be opened directly (Angi blocks automated fetches), so these are directory-sourced only, the same standard the mapper used for Destiny, Silvana and JVL.
issues.fix: Add both, or add a note explaining why Angi-only cleaners were kept in some cases and dropped in others.

issues.problem: All Jersey Painting LLC (874 Fox Meadow Rd, North Brunswick, 732-579-7546) appears on a local directory page but is not in the list. Single weak source, so it is a lead rather than a confirmed miss.
issues.fix: Spot-check by phone or a second directory; add if confirmed.

issues.claim: Several entries with address 'Unknown' actually have a published address
issues.problem: Stearn Brothers Construction is listed at 'Unknown', but its own site / directories place it at 178 Blackhorse Ln, North Brunswick (directory-sourced only; I confirmed the company and its roofing focus on its own site, not the address). TEMPRO Heating & Cooling is listed with no website, but temprohvac.com is live and confirms North Brunswick HVAC work; High Quality Affordable Painters is listed with address and phone 'Unknown' although a Birdeye profile shows 500 Adams Ln and a 5.0 rating from ~266 reviews.
issues.fix: Fill in the address/website/phone fields for these three; they are among the better-qualified entries in the list.

issues.claim: North Brunswick HVAC Cleaning Services, 18 Eden Ct (Google Maps only)
issues.problem: Generic, home-based name supported only by a Maps query URL, with no business-specific page found. Could not be opened or corroborated.
issues.fix: Treat as unverified until a business-specific listing or phone contact confirms it; consider dropping it, since a generic name plus a residential address and a Maps-only source is the same profile the mapper excluded elsewhere.

issues.claim: Aspenn Environmental Services, 1430 Jersey Ave, listed as a local pest-control operator
issues.problem: Not an exclusion failure, but the company is larger than the list implies: multi-state coverage (CT, DE, MD, MA, NJ, NY, PA, RI, VA, DC) with additional locations in VA, RI and PA, and linkedin/BBB show HQ at 1430 Jersey Ave, Suite 1, North Brunswick.
issues.fix: No action required for eligibility (HQ is in-zone); add a note that this is a multi-state company with a local HQ so the team pitches the HQ, not a branch.
